answer.held_back_by: I don't think anything held me back, because I became Prime Minister at 59. The only drag was STAND, which kept sliding despite glowing appraisals, and I never learned why. My guess is that answering straight every year cost me something the game never explained.
answer.ending_fair_why: I reached the top job and the card ties the pay to a formula I asked about at Y16, which is a neat bit of design. It was less fair that STAND fell for years without a visible cause, and several of my open threads were never resolved.
answer.chase_next: I'd try a run where I leak and cut corners early to see whether the Y1 leak and the Y4 statement ever resurface. I'd also try choosing something other than A, because I want to know what STAND actually responds to.
answer.play_again_why: The yearly events repeated so much that I only ever picked A, and I'd want a reason to expect more variety before another go. I'd probably return later to try a reckless run.
